(2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a pink bottle of detergent held over a white bathroom sink, followed by hands applying the liquid to a beige triangular sponge and rubbing it under a steady stream of water from a chrome faucet. (3) Hands are seen scrubbing the beige sponge against a translucent bar of soap in the sink, then squeezing multiple sponges under running water, causing brownish foundation residue to wash away as the water gradually turns clear. (4) The woman returns to the frame, holding the mesh basket to the camera and speaking enthusiastically while gesturing; she demonstrates how the basket can be hung, with the bright indoor lighting highlighting the clean sponges inside.
